chk_account_worth_capture_header.name: chk_account_worth_capture_header
chk_account_worth_capture_header.value:
isfinite("account_worth_captures"."date") AND isfinite("account_worth_captures"."captured_at")
    AND isfinite("account_worth_captures"."created_at") AND isfinite("account_worth_captures"."updated_at")
    AND ("account_worth_captures"."currency" IS NULL OR "account_worth_captures"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

idx_accounts_household.name: idx_accounts_household
idx_accounts_household.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND is_archived = FALSE

idx_accounts_household_asset.name: idx_accounts_household_asset
idx_accounts_household_asset.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND is_hidden = FALSE

chk_budget_warning_threshold.name: chk_budget_warning_threshold
chk_budget_warning_threshold.value: warning_threshold IS NULL OR (warning_threshold >= 0 AND warning_threshold <= 100)

chk_budget_alert_threshold.name: chk_budget_alert_threshold
chk_budget_alert_threshold.value: alert_threshold IS NULL OR (alert_threshold >= 0 AND alert_threshold <= 200)

durable_job_attempts_outcome.name: durable_job_attempts_outcome
durable_job_attempts_outcome.value: (generation > 0 AND octet_length(worker_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND isfinite(claimed_at) AND isfinite(last_lease_at) AND last_lease_at >= claimed_at AND checkpoint_version_before >= 0 AND outcome IN ('running','yielded','succeeded','retryable_failed','permanent_failed','expired','unknown') AND ((outcome = 'running' AND finished_at IS NULL AND checkpoint_version_after IS NULL AND error_code IS NULL) OR (outcome <> 'running' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(finished_at) AND finished_at >= last_lease_at AND checkpoint_version_after IS NOT NULL AND checkpoint_version_after >= checkpoint_version_before AND ((outcome IN ('yielded','succeeded') AND error_code IS NULL) OR (outcome IN ('retryable_failed','permanent_failed','expired','unknown') AND error_code ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,95}$'))))) IS TRUE

durable_job_items_scope_due_bounds.name: durable_job_items_scope_due_bounds
durable_job_items_scope_due_bounds.value: octet_length(job_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 96 AND octet_length(scope_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND octet_length(due_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND octet_length(job_name) + octet_length(scope_key) + octet_length(due_key) <= 1024 AND due_kind IN ('business-date','period','event') AND jsonb_typeof(scope) = 'object'

durable_job_items_scope_canonical.name: durable_job_items_scope_canonical
durable_job_items_scope_canonical.value:
((scope = '{"kind":"global"}'::jsonb AND scope_key = '["global"]') OR
    (scope->>'kind' = 'household' AND scope = jsonb_build_object('kind','household','householdId',scope->>'householdId') AND scope->>'householdId' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND scope_key = format('["household","%s"]',scope->>'householdId')) OR
    (scope->>'kind' = 'user' AND scope = jsonb_build_object('kind','user','userId',scope->>'userId') AND scope->>'userId' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND scope_key = format('["user","%s"]',scope->>'userId')) OR
    (scope->>'kind' = 'household-resource' AND scope = jsonb_build_object('kind','household-resource','householdId',scope->>'householdId','resourceType',scope->>'resourceType','resourceId',scope->>'resourceId') AND scope->>'householdId' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND scope->>'resourceId' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND scope->>'resourceType' ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]{0,63}$' AND scope_key = format('["household-resource","%s","%s","%s"]',scope->>'householdId',scope->>'resourceType',scope->>'resourceId'))) IS TRUE

durable_job_items_payload_policy_bounds.name: durable_job_items_payload_policy_bounds
durable_job_items_payload_policy_bounds.value: (octet_length(payload_text) <= 65536 AND payload_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND octet_length(policy_text) <= 2048 AND policy_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND jsonb_typeof(payload_text::jsonb) IN ('object','array','string','number','boolean','null') AND r14_durable_policy_valid(policy_text)) IS TRUE

durable_job_items_state_claim.name: durable_job_items_state_claim
durable_job_items_state_claim.value: (state IN ('queued','running','retry_wait','succeeded','dead','outcome_unknown') AND ((state = 'running' AND generation > 0 AND claim_count = generation AND claim_token IS NOT NULL AND worker_id IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(claimed_at) AND isfinite(lease_until) AND claimed_at < lease_until AND octet_length(worker_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) OR (state <> 'running' AND claim_token IS NULL AND worker_id IS NULL AND claimed_at IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL))) IS TRUE

durable_job_items_counts.name: durable_job_items_counts
durable_job_items_counts.value: generation >= 0 AND claim_count >= 0 AND claim_count = generation AND failure_count >= 0 AND checkpoint_version >= 0 AND (checkpoint IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(checkpoint) = 'object' AND octet_length(checkpoint::text) <= 16384)) AND (result IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(result) = 'object' AND octet_length(result::text) <= 16384))

durable_job_items_terminal.name: durable_job_items_terminal
durable_job_items_terminal.value: ((state IN ('succeeded','dead','outcome_unknown')) = (terminal_at IS NOT NULL)) AND (last_error_code IS NULL OR last_error_code ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,95}$')

chk_grz_bonds_sale_settlement.name: chk_grz_bonds_sale_settlement
chk_grz_bonds_sale_settlement.value:
("grz_bonds"."sale_cash_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "grz_bonds"."sale_fees" IS NULL
    AND "grz_bonds"."sale_cost_basis" IS NULL AND "grz_bonds"."sale_realized_gain" IS NULL)
    OR ("grz_bonds"."sale_cash_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grz_bonds"."status"='sold' AND "grz_bonds"."sold_date" IS NOT NULL AND "grz_bonds"."sold_price" IS NOT NULL
    AND "grz_bonds"."sale_fees" IS NOT NULL AND "grz_bonds"."sale_cost_basis" IS NOT NULL AND "grz_bonds"."sale_realized_gain" IS NOT NULL
    AND "grz_bonds"."sale_fees">=0 AND "grz_bonds"."sold_price">"grz_bonds"."sale_fees" AND "grz_bonds"."sale_cost_basis">0
    AND "grz_bonds"."sold_price"::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') AND "grz_bonds"."sale_fees"::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    AND "grz_bonds"."sale_cost_basis"::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    AND "grz_bonds"."sale_realized_gain"="grz_bonds"."sold_price"-"grz_bonds"."sale_fees"-"grz_bonds"."sale_cost_basis")

chk_grz_tbills_maturity_terms.name: chk_grz_tbills_maturity_terms
chk_grz_tbills_maturity_terms.value:
("grz_tbills"."maturity_withholding_tax" IS NULL AND "grz_tbills"."maturity_net_proceeds" IS NULL AND "grz_tbills"."status"::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'awaiting_receipt')
    OR ("grz_tbills"."maturity_withholding_tax" IS NOT NULL AND "grz_tbills"."maturity_net_proceeds" IS NOT NULL
    AND "grz_tbills"."status"::text IN ('awaiting_receipt','matured') AND "grz_tbills"."maturity_withholding_tax">=0
    AND "grz_tbills"."maturity_withholding_tax"::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    AND "grz_tbills"."maturity_net_proceeds"="grz_tbills"."face_value"-"grz_tbills"."maturity_withholding_tax")

chk_grz_tbills_receipt_settlement.name: chk_grz_tbills_receipt_settlement
chk_grz_tbills_receipt_settlement.value:
("grz_tbills"."settlement_operation_id" IS NULL AND "grz_tbills"."settlement_request_digest" IS NULL
    AND "grz_tbills"."settlement_cash_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "grz_tbills"."settlement_receipt_date" IS NULL)
    OR ("grz_tbills"."settlement_operation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grz_tbills"."settlement_request_digest" IS NOT NULL
    AND "grz_tbills"."settlement_cash_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grz_tbills"."settlement_receipt_date" IS NOT NULL
    AND "grz_tbills"."status"::text='matured' AND "grz_tbills"."maturity_net_proceeds" IS NOT NULL AND "grz_tbills"."maturity_investment_tx_id" IS NOT NULL
    AND "grz_tbills"."settlement_receipt_date">="grz_tbills"."maturity_date")

household_fx_rate_override_date_ck.name: household_fx_rate_override_date_ck
household_fx_rate_override_date_ck.value:
"household_fx_rate_overrides"."effective_date" BETWEEN DATE '0001-01-01' AND DATE '9999-12-31'
      AND "household_fx_rate_overrides"."valid_through" BETWEEN "household_fx_rate_overrides"."effective_date" AND DATE '9999-12-31'

household_security_price_override_date_c.name: household_security_price_override_date_ck
household_security_price_override_date_c.value:
"household_security_price_overrides"."effective_date" BETWEEN DATE '0001-01-01' AND DATE '9999-12-31'
      AND "household_security_price_overrides"."valid_through" BETWEEN "household_security_price_overrides"."effective_date" AND DATE '9999-12-31'

investment_sip_confirmation_cardinality.name: investment_sip_confirmation_cardinality
investment_sip_confirmation_cardinality.value: ("investment_sip_confirmations"."outcome"='unfilled' AND "investment_sip_confirmations"."fill_count"=0) OR ("investment_sip_confirmations"."outcome" IN ('filled','partially_filled') AND "investment_sip_confirmations"."fill_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

investment_sip_confirmation_reference.name: investment_sip_confirmation_reference
investment_sip_confirmation_reference.value: "investment_sip_confirmations"."broker_reference" IS NULL OR (char_length("investment_sip_confirmations"."broker_reference") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "investment_sip_confirmations"."broker_reference" ~ '[^[:space:]]')

provider_fx_quote_valid.name: provider_fx_quote_valid
provider_fx_quote_valid.value:
"provider_fx_quotes"."rate" > 0 AND "provider_fx_quotes"."rate"::text NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity')
    AND isfinite("provider_fx_quotes"."quoted_at") AND isfinite("provider_fx_quotes"."valid_through") AND isfinite("provider_fx_quotes"."recorded_at")
    AND "provider_fx_quotes"."valid_through" BETWEEN "provider_fx_quotes"."effective_date" AND "provider_fx_quotes"."effective_date" + 3
    AND "provider_fx_quotes"."effective_date" = ("provider_fx_quotes"."quoted_at" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
    AND "provider_fx_quotes"."quoted_at" <= "provider_fx_quotes"."recorded_at"
    AND "provider_fx_quotes"."provider" IN ('yahoo_finance', 'exchangerate_api')
    AND "provider_fx_quotes"."from_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND "provider_fx_quotes"."to_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
    AND "provider_fx_quotes"."from_currency" <> "provider_fx_quotes"."to_currency"

transaction_create_transfer_pair.name: transaction_create_transfer_pair
transaction_create_transfer_pair.value:
CASE WHEN "transaction_create_owner_intents"."operation" = 'transfer'
    THEN "transaction_create_owner_intents"."transfer_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transaction_create_owner_intents"."transfer_inflow_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transaction_create_owner_intents"."transfer_inflow_id" <> "transaction_create_owner_intents"."transaction_id"
    ELSE "transaction_create_owner_intents"."transfer_group_id" IS NULL AND "transaction_create_owner_intents"."transfer_inflow_id" IS NULL END

transaction_create_request_digest.name: transaction_create_request_digest
transaction_create_request_digest.value:
CASE WHEN "transaction_create_owner_intents"."operation" = 'transfer'
    THEN "transaction_create_owner_intents"."request_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "transaction_create_owner_intents"."request_digest" ~ '^t1:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND NOT "transaction_create_owner_intents"."owner_selected"
    ELSE "transaction_create_owner_intents"."request_digest" IS NULL OR ("transaction_create_owner_intents"."operation" = 'ordinary' AND "transaction_create_owner_intents"."request_digest" ~ '^v1:[0-9a-f]{64}$') END

idx_transactions_category_date.name: idx_transactions_category_date
idx_transactions_category_date.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND is_excluded_from_reports = FALSE

idx_transactions_pending.name: idx_transactions_pending
idx_transactions_pending.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND is_pending = TRUE

chk_transaction_posting_receipt.name: chk_transaction_posting_receipt
chk_transaction_posting_receipt.value:
(
    (posting_mode IS NULL AND posted_account_is_asset IS NULL AND posted_balance_delta IS NULL)
    OR (posting_mode IS NOT NULL AND posted_account_is_asset IS NOT NULL AND posted_balance_delta IS NOT NULL
      AND currency IS NOT NULL AND currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
      AND posted_balance_delta::text NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity')
      AND (posting_mode = 'posted' OR (posting_mode = 'history_only' AND posted_balance_delta = 0)))
  )

idx_users_backup_codes_expiry.name: idx_users_backup_codes_expiry
idx_users_backup_codes_expiry.where: mfa_enabled = true AND mfa_backup_codes IS NOT NULL

ck_grz_valuation_quote.name: ck_grz_valuation_quote
ck_grz_valuation_quote.value:
"grz_bond_valuations"."quote_basis" in ('clean','dirty') and "grz_bond_valuations"."quote_units" in ('holding_amount','per_100_nominal')
    and "grz_bond_valuations"."nominal_amount">0 and "grz_bond_valuations"."nominal_amount"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
    and "grz_bond_valuations"."quoted_amount">0 and "grz_bond_valuations"."quoted_amount"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
    and ("grz_bond_valuations"."accrued_quote" is null or ("grz_bond_valuations"."accrued_quote">=0 and "grz_bond_valuations"."accrued_quote"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'))

ck_grz_valuation_components.name: ck_grz_valuation_components
ck_grz_valuation_components.value:
"grz_bond_valuations"."dirty_value">=0 and "grz_bond_valuations"."dirty_value"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' and
    (("grz_bond_valuations"."clean_value" is null and "grz_bond_valuations"."accrued_value" is null) or
    ("grz_bond_valuations"."clean_value" is not null and "grz_bond_valuations"."accrued_value" is not null and "grz_bond_valuations"."clean_value">=0 and "grz_bond_valuations"."accrued_value">=0
      and "grz_bond_valuations"."clean_value"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' and "grz_bond_valuations"."accrued_value"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
      and "grz_bond_valuations"."clean_value"+"grz_bond_valuations"."accrued_value"="grz_bond_valuations"."dirty_value"))

chk_grz_principal_basis_terms.name: chk_grz_principal_basis_terms
chk_grz_principal_basis_terms.value:
"grz_bond_principal_basis"."authority"='member_recorded' and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."currency"='ZMW'
    and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."source_date">="grz_bond_principal_basis"."acquisition_date" and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."source_kind" in ('custodian_statement','trade_confirmation','contract_note')
    and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."source_reference" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
    and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."principal_cost">0 and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."purchased_interest">=0 and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."acquisition_fees">=0 and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."nominal_amount">0
    and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."purchase_cash_amount"="grz_bond_principal_basis"."principal_cost"+"grz_bond_principal_basis"."purchased_interest"+"grz_bond_principal_basis"."acquisition_fees"
    and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."principal_cost"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."purchased_interest"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
    and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."acquisition_fees"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."purchase_cash_amount"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
    and "grz_bond_principal_basis"."nominal_amount"::text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'

chk_grz_principal_state.name: chk_grz_principal_state
chk_grz_principal_state.value:
"grz_principal_settlements"."status" in ('pending','confirmed') and "grz_principal_settlements"."currency"='ZMW'
    and "grz_principal_settlements"."received_amount">0 and "grz_principal_settlements"."fees">=0
    and "grz_principal_settlements"."principal_amount"="grz_principal_settlements"."received_amount"+"grz_principal_settlements"."fees"
    and "grz_principal_settlements"."principal_amount"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    and "grz_principal_settlements"."received_amount"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    and "grz_principal_settlements"."fees"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    and (("grz_principal_settlements"."basis_id" is null and "grz_principal_settlements"."cost_basis" is null and "grz_principal_settlements"."realized_basis_difference" is null
      and "grz_principal_settlements"."purchased_interest" is null and "grz_principal_settlements"."acquisition_fees" is null and "grz_principal_settlements"."basis_evidence" is null)
      or ("grz_principal_settlements"."basis_id" is not null and "grz_principal_settlements"."cost_basis" is not null and "grz_principal_settlements"."realized_basis_difference" is not null
        and "grz_principal_settlements"."purchased_interest" is not null and "grz_principal_settlements"."acquisition_fees" is not null
        and "grz_principal_settlements"."cost_basis">0 and "grz_principal_settlements"."purchased_interest">=0 and "grz_principal_settlements"."acquisition_fees">=0
        and "grz_principal_settlements"."cost_basis"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') and "grz_principal_settlements"."purchased_interest"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
        and "grz_principal_settlements"."acquisition_fees"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') and "grz_principal_settlements"."basis_evidence" is not null
        and "grz_principal_settlements"."realized_basis_difference"="grz_principal_settlements"."principal_amount"-"grz_principal_settlements"."cost_basis"))
    and (("grz_principal_settlements"."status"='pending' and "grz_principal_settlements"."cash_transaction_id" is null and "grz_principal_settlements"."investment_transaction_id" is null and "grz_principal_settlements"."confirmed_at" is null
      and "grz_principal_settlements"."valuation_id" is null and "grz_principal_settlements"."valuation" is null)
      or ("grz_principal_settlements"."status"='confirmed' and "grz_principal_settlements"."cash_transaction_id" is not null and "grz_principal_settlements"."investment_transaction_id" is not null
        and "grz_principal_settlements"."basis_id" is not null and "grz_principal_settlements"."valuation_id" is not null and "grz_principal_settlements"."valuation" is not null and "grz_principal_settlements"."confirmed_at" is not null))
